items.title: SpaceX’s Starship rocket reaches orbit for the first time
items.caption_facebook:

The plan was for Starship to circle Earth six times over nine hours and drop 26 new Starlink satellites, though it's unclear if that held up. The booster landed cleaner than ever in a simulated touchdown over the Gulf.

This matters because cheaper, reusable rockets could open space work to way more people, not just the big players.

Would cheaper rockets open space up to more builders, not just billionaires? #TheInnovatorsDen

Milwaukee hit 154 homers, 28th in MLB, but scored 832 runs and won 103 games. In the Series the teams combined for four homers. The same Rays swept the Yankees, who hit 223 homers, out of the ALDS. Paul O'Neill's 10-pitch walk in Game 1 of the 2000 Subway Series is still the blueprint. More power or more grit for the Yankees? Tell us below.

By The Innovators Den. Sources: MLB.com, CBS News, AP, FOX Sports, StatMuse. #TheInnovatorsDen #Yankees

items.title: Fuerza Regida Won Miami. The Bronx Bachata Kings Stole It.
items.caption_facebook:
The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards aired Oct. 22 from Miami. Fuerza Regida led with eight wins, four for "Marlboro Rojo," and Bad Bunny won seven including Artist of the Year. Karol G took the first Fan Artist award and Rosalía entered the Billboard Hall of Fame. For New York, the moment belonged to Bronx-born Romeo Santos and Prince Royce, whose "Lokita Por Mí" won Tropical Song and Latin Airplay Song and whose surprise album "Better Late Than Never" won Top Tropical Album. Who had the best year in Latin music? Tell us below.

By The Innovators Den. Sources: Telemundo, Hola, CelebrityAccess, Complex, Boston Globe. #TheInnovatorsDen #PremiosBillboard
